in_marathi.name: Chaviya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaviya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chandra-vakya' which means 'Goddess of knowledge'. In Hindu mythology, Chaviya is revered as the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge. She is also believed to be the goddess of speech and eloquence.
